expression: white horse being ridden by a police officer
program:
def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    horses = image_patch.find("white horse")
    officers = image_patch.find("police officer")
    
    if not horses or not officers:
        return []
    
    horse_officer_pairs = [(horse, officer) for horse in horses for officer in officers if horse.overlaps_with(officer.left, officer.lower, officer.right, officer.upper)]
    
    return horse_officer_pairs
